data.one_liner: Provides a Dio interceptor and pretty printer for Loggy logs.
data.what_it_does: Adds a Dio interceptor that logs request and response data using Loggy. It formats logs in a readable, pretty style.
use_when: You already use Loggy for logging and want to log Dio network calls
You need pretty, structured logs for debugging HTTP requests
You want a quick way to add logging to an existing Dio client
avoid_when: You are not using Loggy or prefer another logging solution
You need advanced network features beyond logging
You are targeting a platform that does not support Dio
strengths: Easy integration with existing Loggy setup
weaknesses: Only works with Loggy, not standalone
No additional network functionality beyond logging
Limited to Dio, not other HTTP clients
